_meta.note: General guidance. Recycling rules differ between municipalities - always check the local rules printed on the bins.
sources: US EPA - How do I recycle common recyclables: https://www.epa.gov/recycle/how-do-i-recycle-common-recyclables
T.C. Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı - Sıfır Atık (Zero Waste) colour code

cardboard.name: Cardboard
tips: Remove tape, plastic film and foam
Greasy pizza boxes go to general waste
cardboard.fact: Cardboard can be recycled 5–7 times before the fibres become too short.

glass.name: Glass
tips: Remove metal caps (recycle them with metal)
Window glass, mirrors and ceramics are NOT accepted
glass.fact: Glass can be recycled endlessly without losing quality.

metal.name: Metal
tips: Aluminium foil is recyclable if clean
Aerosol cans only when completely empty
metal.fact: Recycling aluminium saves about 95% of the energy needed to make it from raw ore.

paper.name: Paper
tips: Shredded paper: put it in a paper bag
Tissues and napkins go to general waste
paper.fact: Paper fibres can be recycled about 5–7 times.

plastic.name: Plastic
tips: Check the recycling number (1 PET and 2 HDPE are most widely accepted)
plastic.fact: Only about 9% of all plastic ever produced has been recycled - sorting correctly matters.

trash.name: General waste
tips: Dirty or mixed-material packaging belongs here
Batteries and electronics need special collection points
Food scraps: use compost / organic bins where available
trash.fact: Reducing and reusing comes before recycling in the waste hierarchy.
